name: 暗场赤焰真无线半入耳耳机款

shots.intent: 以主板芯片微距解释无线连接机制，暗场技术感替代空喊参数

shots.intent: 回到曜黑展台用一句主张加按钮收口，与首屏呼应完成闭环
shots.textZone: two-line headline above the product, one support line, one rounded action button at the lower centre

style.backgroundSystem: alternating near-black #12141C showcase fields and #FFFFFF / #F2F3F5 infographic plates, with one pale #E9F0F4 spec plate and one light-grey #E6E9ED versus field; depth on the dark screens comes only from vertical #E0455A light streaks and a fine film grain
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight #2D2D2D line icons inside hairline circles, rounded #F2F3F5 cards with hairline dividers and short Latin micro-labels, hairline #9AA0A8 arrows and leader lines with dot terminators, one small outlined corner badge per dark panel, dark #2D2D2D versus a grey #8E9299 label pill for two-column comparisons
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral soft studio key at about 6500K from the front-left, a hard #E0455A rim grazing the shell edges on dark screens, a #4A7FA8 wash inside technical macro renders, raking side light for texture close-ups, and an always-present soft contact shadow under every product and podium
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tech audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a near-black field #12141C, a deep charcoal panel #1E2230 and a clean copy plate #FFFFFF with one mist-grey card #F2F3F5, accent #E0455A and one soft secondary #4A7FA8, text #2D2D2D on light plates and #FFFFFF on dark fields; cool neutral soft studio key at about 6500K from the front-left, a hard #E0455A rim on shell edges, a #4A7FA8 wash in technical macro renders and a constant soft contact shadow under every item; modern geometric sans-serif with short two-line Chinese headlines wrapped in corner brackets and one hairline rule beneath; alternating near-black showcase fields and #FFFFFF infographic plates, one pale #E9F0F4 spec plate and one light-grey #E6E9ED versus field, depth carried only by vertical #E0455A light streaks and fine film grain; shared stage language of matte #12141C and brushed-metal cylindrical podiums with a crimson rim gradient; consistent thin single-weight line icons inside hairline circles, rounded #F2F3F5 cards with hairline dividers and short Latin micro-labels, hairline #9AA0A8 arrows and leader lines with dot terminators, one small outlined corner badge per dark panel; stable product scale and centring, matte and gloss shell finishes rendered separately, colourways taken only from the reference; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers.
noDrift: no invented spec numbers or certifications
no warped straight lines or distorted podium ellipses
style.presentationRules: one identical earbud-and-case silhouette across the set, hinge-open cases centred on their own podium, shells shown with matte and gloss finishes rendered separately, colourways taken only from the reference with no recolouring, stable scale and centring between screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte #12141C and brushed-metal cylindrical podiums with a crimson rim gradient, a navy-grained plinth block, glossy black desk surface for still-life, #FFFFFF and mist-grey #F2F3F5 copy plates for information screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; two-line #FFFFFF Chinese headlines on the dark fields and #2D2D2D headlines on the light plates, one hairline rule under every headline, three-layer copy only, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and carried as placeholders
